answer: Epoch rationing on one sequential chain: identities claim heartbeat steps from a chain admitting 72 steps per epoch. Each bridge commits to the prior bridge hash, so steps cannot be reordered, batched, or precomputed. A yarrow draw from the public beacon orders the queue, blocking slot pre-allocation to clones. Every identity locks a ferrous bond; missing two steps burns 40 percent. A clone farm adds no throughput, only contention: 500 clones split the same 72 steps, each starves and burns bond. Attacker cost is super-linear in identity count while one honest agent keeps standing.
